name: kubernetes-the-hard-way
description_en: Bootstrap Kubernetes the hard way. No scripts.
readme_excerpt: Kubernetes The Hard Way This tutorial walks you through setting up Kubernetes the hard way. This guide is not for someone looking for a fully automated tool to bring up a Kubernetes cluster.
